def test_low_stock_is_sorted():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 2)
    s.add("gadget", 1)
    s.add("doohickey", 9)
    assert s.low_stock(5) == ["gadget", "widget"]


def test_low_stock_excludes_level_at_threshold():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 5)
    s.add("gadget", 4)
    assert s.low_stock(5) == ["gadget"]


def test_low_stock_empty_when_nothing_is_low():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 10)
    assert s.low_stock(5) == []


def test_low_stock_includes_sku_emptied_to_zero():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("widget", 3)
    s.remove("widget", 3)
    assert s.low_stock(1) == ["widget"]


def test_low_stock_on_empty_stock():
    assert Stock().low_stock(5) == []
